title: Signup Checkbox STILL causes infinite loop (BUG-027 fix failed)
description: BUG-027 was marked complete but the checkbox still causes 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Previous fixes (stopPropagation, pointer-events-none) did not work. Need fresh investigation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reproduce: Go to /signup, click anywhere on the checkbox card
Investigate: The error comes from setRef in Radix internals, not onClick handlers
Check: Label htmlFor='migrate' may be triggering checkbox programmatically
Check: Radix Checkbox internal state management with controlled checked prop
Fix: Checkbox card can be clicked without any console errors
Fix: Checkbox toggles state correctly on click
Fix: Rapid clicking does not cause errors
Verify in browser: Full signup flow works with checkbox checked and unchecked

notes:
FULL ERROR TRACE:
```
Error: Maximum update depth exceeded.
at getRootForUpdatedFiber (react-dom_client.js)
at enqueueConcurrentHookUpdate (react-dom_client.js)
at dispatchSetStateInternal (react-dom_client.js)
at dispatchSetState (react-dom_client.js)
at chunk-NGT4BZXR.js:119:7
at setRef (chunk-2VUH7NEY.js:12:12)
```

The error is in a <span> component (likely CheckboxPrimitive.Indicator).

FAILED FIXES:
1. BUG-027: Added onClick stopPropagation - didn't work (Radix events separate from DOM)
2. Hotfix: Removed onCheckedChange, added pointer-events-none - didn't work

POSSIBLE CAUSES:
1. Label htmlFor='migrate' clicking the checkbox bypasses pointer-events-none
2. Radix internal ref handling causing infinite setState
3. Controlled component with checked prop conflicting with internal state

TRY:
1. Remove id from Checkbox and htmlFor from Label (break implicit linking)
2. Use uncontrolled checkbox with defaultChecked + ref to read value
3. Replace Radix Checkbox with native HTML checkbox
4. Check Radix version compatibility issues

CRITICAL: CHECK BROWSER CONSOLE LOGS CAREFULLY!
- Open DevTools > Console before clicking
- Note the EXACT component and line numbers in the stack trace
- The error may be in Radix internals, not our code
- If fix doesn't work, create BUG-029 with new findings
